The Antifungal Pen — built to get underneath

Developed by podiatrist Dr. Kent Biehler, the pen does what creams, sprays, and soaks can't — it gets underneath the surrounding skin, where fungus actually lives.

Natural oils (Tea Tree, Oregano, Manuka, Propolis, Clove Bud) soften the surrounding skin and break down the biofilm shield

25% Undecylenic Acid — the strongest antifungal available without a prescription — goes after the fungus at the source

Precise twist-and-brush applicator — no mess, no pills, no side effects

Lunavia

How to use: Twist the pen, brush it over the affected area twice a day. About 30 seconds.

What to expect as you use it

1 — The smell stops

Within the first week, the formula starts absorbing underneath. The odor goes first — the first sign it's losing.

2 — Healthy growth appears

Around week 4, clear growth starts pushing through at the base while the formula keeps working underneath.

3 — The damaged part grows out

By week 8, thick, discolored areas are visibly shrinking as they grow out and get replaced. Mild cases look completely clear at this point.

4 — Clear, normal-looking toes

By weeks 12–16, even severe, long-standing cases have grown out. Just normal, boring feet you won't think twice about showing.
